topic: The Mysterious Death of Gareth Williams (The Spy in the Bag, 2010)
summary: In August 2010, 31-year-old GCHQ codebreaker secondment to MI6, Gareth Williams, was found dead inside a padlocked North Face holdall in the bathtub of his safehouse in Pimlico, London. Despite expert consensus that locking himself inside without leaving forensic traces was physically impossible, official investigations remain fiercely conflicted between state-sponsored murder and accidental death.
research_points: Gareth Williams' top-secret cryptographic work for GCHQ and secondment to MI6 involving sensitive intelligence networks.
The discovery of his body on August 23, 2010, inside a red North Face bag padlocked from the outside inside a bathtub.
Forensic anomalies, including the total absence of fingerprints or foreign DNA on the lock, key, zipper, or edge of the bathtub.
The Coroner's Inquest verdict by Fiona Wilcox concluding he was unlawfully killed by a third party, likely linked to his intelligence work.
The Metropolitan Police's controversial 2013 review that reversed public perception by declaring the death likely an accident.
title: Küvetin İçindeki Kilitli Çantada Bulunan MI6 Ajanı: Gareth Williams Gizemi
description: 2010 yılında Londra'da MI6 için çalışan dahiyane şifre uzmanı Gareth Williams, dairesindeki küvette kilitli bir spor çantasının içinde ölü bulundu. Dışarıdan kilitlenen asma kilitte ne bir parmak izi ne de yabancı bir DNA vardı. Bir insan kendi kendini kilitli bir çantaya hapşedebilir miydi, yoksa uluslararası bir suikasta mı kurban gitti? Gölge Arşivi, İngiliz istihbarat tarihinin en karanlık faili meçhul dosyasını tüm ayrıntılarıyla inceliyor.
